claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for UTxO RPC maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The requested maintenance scope is for a part-time UTxO RPC maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD, with the new grant period beginning after the existing contract closes.
UTxO RPC is an open interface specification using Protocol Buffers with SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python to standardize interactions with UTxO-based blockchains.
The proposal states that Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node have adopted UTxO RPC as a query interface, validating it as an ecosystem standard.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations, and is open-source under Apache 2.0.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested amount is stated not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are stated to be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with overhead and administration fees covering those costs.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

Intersect plans to administer the withdrawn funds through a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-like authorization thresholds, an Oversight Committee, and a public dashboard for auditing.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of UTxO RPC maintenance and administration, presents UTxO RPC as an adopted open-source integration standard, and describes Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, oversight controls, and smart-contract-based fund administration.
